item.title: Fairbanks finishes Freddies’ season to remember in heartbreaking fashion
item.description: FREDERICKTOWN — It was a season to remember in Fredericktown. item.title: Crestview can’t sustain strong start in district semifinal loss to Seneca East
item.description: WILLARD — The first half belonged to Crestview. Seneca East owned the second — and the game.
